messages:
Maya (Finance): Quick postmortem follow-up: we found the delayed ingestion window caused ~12k tokens to not land in the ledger for accounts billed 2026-03. Need owners + timeline for: (1) ledger backfill, (2) invoice adjustments, (3) guardrails to avoid recurrence.
Jorge (SRE): I can take the backfill job. Plan is to run a shadow tally first (replay events to a sandbox ledger) and compare token deltas. ETA for shadow tally: EOD tomorrow.
Liam (Eng): @Jorge ping me when you kick off the replay. I want to capture perf and ensure the kv-collector patch we deployed last week isn't double-counting on replay.
Maya (Finance): Good. For invoices, we need a safe communication plan. Zoe, can Product draft the customer note? We should coordinate timing so credits appear before the email.
Zoe (Product): Yep — I'll draft a short note saying "we detected an ingestion delay that affected token counts; affected accounts will receive automated credits and corrected invoices." Will share draft in #support-drafts by noon tomorrow.
Jorge (SRE): Running shadow tally steps I plan to run:
```
1) snapshot current ledger
2) run event-replay to sandbox with same ingestion window
3) compute per-account token delta
4) generate reconciliation CSV and sanity checks
```
Running with --dry-run first. If numbers align, we will run actual backfill during the 02:00 UTC maintenance window next Tuesday.
Maya (Finance): Owner mapping collection: ledger backfill -> @Jorge; invoice corrections -> @Maya; comms -> @Zoe; QA & monitoring -> @Liam. Please confirm or push back.
Liam (Eng): Confirmed for QA/monitoring. I'll add automated checks to detect ingestion lag > 5 minutes and ship a lightweight alert to #eng-oncall. Also adding a canary that compares streaming vs batch token totals every 15m.
Maya (Finance): For invoicing scope: affected accounts are any with token delta >= 100 in the reconciliation CSV. Manual review for > 10k. I'll prepare a credits spreadsheet and an accounting journal entry template today. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A-example-backfill-credit
Jorge (SRE): Shadow tally finished early — CSV attached to thread (see billing-bot summary). Preliminary delta: 11,829 tokens across 42 accounts. No obvious double-counts on dry-run.
billing-bot: Reconciliation CSV uploaded: gs://redwood-billing/sandbox/recon/1719998765-shadow.csv (preview: 42 rows, 11,829 total delta) :white_check_mark:
Maya (Finance): Thanks. Next steps: Jorge to run production backfill in maintenance window (owner: @Jorge, target: Tue 02:00 UTC), Liam to enable new detection checks (owner: @Liam, target: Mon EOD), Zoe to finalize customer note (owner: @Zoe, target: Mon noon), Maya to queue invoice corrections and credits (owner: @Maya, target: Wed EOD).
Jorge (SRE): One operational note: backfill will create temporary high I/O on the ingestion db; I'll throttle to keep p95 latency below 120ms. If we hit errors, fallback plan is to stage incremental patches per-customer.
Liam (Eng): I'll add a post-run healthcheck that validates token totals match the reconciled CSV within 1%. If mismatch, we'll halt and investigate.
Zoe (Product): I'll prep FAQs and support templates so CS can triage any billing emails.
Maya (Finance): Can everyone add their action to the postmortem ticket (PMT-4238) with the ETA and acceptance criteria? I want a single source of truth.
Jorge (SRE): Added my task to PMT-4238 with logs and replay command example. Command I used: `event-replay --from 2026-03-14T00:00Z --to 2026-03-14T06:00Z --sandbox --output recon.csv --throttle 200`
Liam (Eng): Task added. I'll include the alert runbook and Grafana panel links.
Maya (Finance): Final check: once backfill and credits are applied, I'll do a sample audit on 10 accounts and publish the reconciliation report. If all good, I'll send the customer note within 24h.
Zoe (Product): Sounds good. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
Maya (Finance): Closing loop — recurring pattern insight: ingestion lag spikes at midnight UTC when batch job overlaps with the aggregator. We should consider shifting the aggregator by 30m or split the jobs. I'll log this as longer-term remediation in PMT-4238.
Jorge (SRE): Noted. I'll prototype a staggered schedule and report perf delta next sprint.
